d: If you gain something, you get more of it or achieve it after working hard.
A galaxy is a massive group of stars, dust, and gas held together by gravity.
A gallery is a room or building where you go to look at paintings and other art.
If you gamble, you risk money on a game of chance hoping to win more.
A game is an activity or sport that people play for fun according to rules.
A gang is a group of young people who often cause trouble or commit crimes together.
A gap is an empty space or hole between two solid objects.
A garage is a building where you park your car to keep it safe from the weather.
Garbage is waste food or old paper that you throw away.
A garden is a piece of land next to a house where flowers or vegetables grow.
Garlic is a small plant like an onion with a very strong taste and smell.
A garment is a formal or old-fashioned word for a piece of clothing.
Gas is a substance like air used for cooking or heating, or liquid fuel for cars.
A gate is a door built into a fence or a wall that you can open and close.
If you gather things, you collect them together in one place.
If you gaze at something, you look at it for a long time without looking away.
Gear is the special clothing and equipment that you need for a particular activity.
Gender is the fact of being male or female.
A gene is a tiny part of a cell that controls how a living thing looks and grows.
If a statement is general, it covers the main idea without giving specific details.
If something generally happens, it happens most of the time or in most situations.
If you generate power or ideas, you create or produce them.
A generation is all the people in a society who were born at about the same time.
If someone is generous, they happily give away their money or time to help others.
A genius is a person who has incredibly high intelligence or outstanding creative skill.
If a person is gentle, they are kind, calm, and careful not to hurt anyone.
A gentleman is a polite man who always treats other people with respect.
If you touch something gently, you do it very softly and carefully.
If something is genuine, it is completely real and not a fake.
Geography is the study of the countries, oceans, mountains, and weather of the Earth.
A gesture is a movement you make with your hands or head to express an idea.
If you get something, you receive it or go and bring it back.
A ghost is the spirit of a dead person that living people believe they can see.
If something is giant, it is extremely large compared to normal things.
A gift is something nice that you give to someone without asking for payment.
A girl is a female child or a young woman.
A girlfriend is a female partner in a romantic relationship.
If you give someone something, you hand it to them so that they can keep it.
If you are glad, you feel happy and pleased about a situation.
If you glance at someone, you look at them very quickly and look away.
Glass is a hard, clear material used to make windows and bottles.
If an issue is global, it affects the entire world.
The globe is the planet Earth, or a round map of the world.
Glory is the great praise and respect you get when you achieve something highly important.
A glove is a piece of clothing you wear on your hand to keep it warm.
If you go somewhere, you travel or move to that place.
A goal is something that you hope to achieve in the future.
A goat is a farm animal with horns that is often kept for its milk.
A god is a powerful spirit that people worship in many religions.
Gold is a valuable, shiny yellow metal used to make expensive jewelry.
If something is golden, it is made of gold or is a bright yellow color.
Golf is a sport where players hit a small white ball into holes on a large field.
If something is good, it is pleasant, useful, or of a high quality.
Goods are things that are manufactured to be sold in shops.
A goose is a large water bird that is similar to a duck but bigger.
Gossip is casual conversation about other people, often involving details that are not true.
If a political party governs a country, they officially control and manage it.
The government is the group of people who officially manage and rule a country.
A governor is the official leader of a state or a large political region.
If you grab something, you pick it up suddenly and roughly.
Grace is a smooth, beautiful, and elegant way of moving.
A grade is a letter or number given to a student to show how well they did on a test.
If something happens gradually, it happens very slowly over a long period of time.
Grain is the seed of crops like wheat or rice, used for making food.
Grammar is the set of rules that explain how words are used correctly in a language.
If a building is grand, it is very large, impressive, and beautiful.
Your grandfather is the father of either your mother or your father.
Your grandmother is the mother of either your mother or your father.
If someone in authority grants your request, they officially allow you to have it.
A grape is a small, sweet green or purple fruit that grows in bunches.
If you grasp an object, you hold it very tightly in your hand.
Grass is the common green plant that covers the ground in parks and gardens.
If you are grateful, you feel very thankful because someone has done something kind for you.
A grave is a place in the ground where a dead person is buried.
Gravity is the invisible force that pulls everything down toward the center of the Earth.
If something is great, it is very good, impressive, or large in size.
You use greatly to emphasize that an action or feeling is very strong.
Green is the color of healthy grass and leaves.
If you greet someone, you say hello to them when you meet them.
Grey is the color of a cloudy sky or of ashes.
Grief is a feeling of extreme sadness, especially when someone you love dies.
A grocery is a store that sells everyday food and household supplies.
The ground is the solid surface of the Earth that you walk on outside.
A group is a number of people or things that are together in one place.
When plants or children grow, they become taller and bigger over time.
Growth is the physical process of increasing in size or amount.

A guard is someone whose job is to protect a place or a person from danger.
If you guess something, you give an answer without knowing for sure if it is right.
A guest is a person who is invited to visit your home or attend your party.
A guide is a person who shows tourists around a city or museum.
A guideline is an official rule that advises you on how to do something properly.
Guilt is the terrible feeling of sadness and regret you get when you do something wrong.
If someone is guilty, they have officially committed a crime.
A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by pulling them.
A gun is a dangerous weapon that shoots metal bullets.
A guy is an informal word used to refer to a man or a boy.
A gym is a large room with equipment for people to do physical exercise.
A graduate is a person who has successfully finished their studies at a university.
When you graduate, you successfully complete your university education and receive a degree.
